<!--
  Please do NOT describe the vulnerability here. Public issues are visible
  to everyone immediately, and this project's users keep credentials in
  local files that a disclosed exploit could reach before a fix ships.
-->

**Do not file security reports as public issues.**

Report privately instead — both routes reach the maintainer:

1. **GitHub private vulnerability reporting:** https://github.com/snugprotocol/snug/security/advisories/new
2. **Email:** security@snugprotocol.org

What counts as a security issue, response times, and the safe-harbor terms are in [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/snugprotocol/snug/blob/main/SECURITY.md). If you already opened a public issue by accident, delete its body, and send the details through one of the routes above.
